note: Issue 471, natives.md sections 7 and 11. A governor below neutral and above the floor answers a tribe's ask for help himself and tells the PC afterwards. Placeholder prose.

body.text: The {param:tribe} asked for {param:resource} for some trouble of theirs beyond the hills.
I have sent it. They have been good neighbours, and I would rather they stayed so.
I did not think the matter would keep for a letter to you and back.

options.text: sorry you did not write to me first
